stem: Which sentence below would best follow and support sentence 15?

options.label: A
options.text: Adequate protection is vital because just one blistering sunburn in childhood or adolescence greatly increases a person’s risk of developing melanoma later in life.

options.label: B
options.text: So teens must learn to avoid tanning beds, but they must also learn to stay out of the sun during the summer.

options.label: C
options.text: Sun exposure can be life threatening to people who have lighter skin, but everyone should learn to be cautious in the sun.

options.label: D
options.text: There are many ways to achieve this goal that teens will surely want to investigate.
